title: PassProtection
description: A pass-protection scheme (full slide, half-slide, max protection, etc.) that describes OL + skill-position assignments as a protection unit.

scheme_id.description: Stable identifier (kebab-case). Must match the filename (without .yaml).

description.description: 1-3 sentence explanation — direction of slide, who scans for the unblocked rusher, when used.

protection_type.description: How many protectors and what the assignment style is.

assignments_by_position.description: Map of position label to assignment rule. Must cover all 5 OL (LT/LG/C/RG/RT) plus HB, and TE if it is part of the protection.

vulnerable_to.description: Blitz packages, stunts, or overloads that beat this protection.

pairs_with.description: Pass concept IDs or formations that commonly use this protection.
